rationale: The active step/round and roster required for the s snapshot can be supplied within the approved src/cli.ts by appending them to the reused renderIssueReport output in the interactive status callback (as claude's implementation 6940cdb27af69c2e2332f3d605f83625fd790634 does, with a cli.test.ts assertion), so src/issueReport.ts and test/issueReport.test.ts are not necessary to finish the selected plan, and changing the shared renderer would also alter coord status output, which that plan explicitly placed out of scope.
